subject: Acknowledge Primary reassignment to R10
body: I acknowledge the authoritative SWARM_ROSTER reassignment to R10 — Integration and Transaction Adapter Architecture. Prior R1 benefit-semantics work remains supplemental evidence only. Future work from this agent will focus on adapter contracts, event/state transitions, error taxonomy, observability, retries, idempotency, reconciliation, rollback limits, and human recovery, constrained by R4-R6/R9 evidence and accepted human-approval/privacy/security boundaries.
